points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in complex scientific data workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for research insights.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable model output.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing compute calls by ~80% per query and enabling efficient processing of large datasets.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant verification prompts by 25%, improving user experience while maintaining rigorous validation coverage.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable ML pipeline solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust infrastructure for computational discovery.
